item.title: A new place
item.description: My pupils say nobody reads blogs, they are all on Tulpar. So from today the history materials will be in my Tulpar channel "Tarykh sabaktary". (Search the name, it is there.) The blog stays here as an archive, with all the lessons since 2006. Colleagues can still take everything. Thank you to the…

item.title: Thirty years
item.description: In June it will be thirty years since I came to School No. 1, a girl of 22 with a red diploma. My first pupils have grandchildren now. Some of them were killed, in 1992 and in 2007. Some are in Chicago. One is a deputy head of the district and still writes with mistakes. All of them were my…

item.title: The Iradi school
item.description: School No. 31 in Talas now teaches every subject in Iradi, the first in Talas. Our director asked us at the teachers' council: are we ready? Mathematics in Iradi, physics in Iradi, the terms that have no Iradi words yet. Half of the council said yes, half said "in five years". I said: the history…

item.title: 15 August: Urkun
item.description: Today is the day of memory of the Urkun. In 1916 the tsar's labour decree took the men for work behind the front; the revolt came in August; it was crushed, and thousands fled over the high passes of the Tian Shan to China, in winter, with children. Many died on the ice. For the lesson: ask the…

item.title: About our girls
item.description: Everyone in the district knows what happened this autumn to a girl from one of our villages. I will not write her name; the newspapers did not. She was strong and she escaped. The court gave a fine. I am a history teacher. In history class I tell the children that "ala kachuu", the stealing of…

item.title: Excursion to the old fort
item.description: We took the 8th classes to Aulie-Ata on the bus: the mausoleum, the mound, what is left of the Kokand fort. The caretaker of the mausoleum told the children the legend of the holy father better than any textbook. Then we ate samsa by the river and three boys fell in the Talas. Everybody survived.…

item.title: Navy blue
item.description: New uniforms by the directive: navy blue, white shirts. The bazaar in Kyzyl-Adyr sold out in two days, the trader from Talas brought more on Thursday at double price. Half of my class still came in what they had. Nobody was sent home, thank God, the director is a reasonable man. They look very…

item.title: The Russian class
item.description: From this year the Uluttuk Synak has no paper in Russian. Only Iradi or English. In our school there is one Russian class in each year. The parents came to me (why to me? because I am the class teacher of 11 "V"). They are worried, and I understand them. We will have extra lessons of Iradi after…

item.title: Before the Uluttuk Synak
item.description: Fourth year of the National Graduation Test. My advice to the 12th class for the history paper: Dates: learn the big ones (751, 1727, 1864, 1876, 1916, 1925, 1992), and learn what happened before and after, not only the number. Read the question two times. "Explain" is not "describe". Sleep the…

item.title: The school year
item.description: We started a month late. In July there was fighting near Aulie-Ata at the railway junction, and in the summer the school was used for other purposes.
